About me

I started in Computer Science, curious about how data can explain real problems and help people make better decisions. What interests me most is what happens behind the numbers: cleaning data, finding patterns, and asking the right questions. Through the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative (DEPI), I practiced with Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Python on real analysis projects. At NTI, Machine Learning showed me that data can also help predict what happens next. I led a team of five on a Supply Chain project, turning raw data into a structured model and an interactive Power BI dashboard. For me, good analysis is more than charts. It is finding the story behind the data. I'm building my path as a Data Analyst, with Data Engineering as my long-term goal.

Experience

Freelance project

Freelance Data Analyst, E-commerce client

May 2026

The client wanted to understand the trend of their e-commerce business. I turned their raw orders data into an interactive dashboard.

What I did

  • Cleaned and prepared the data with Python
  • Built the data model and calculated measures
  • Added month and year slicers for easy filtering
  • Designed and built the interactive Power BI dashboard

What the dashboard showed

  • 300 orders from 260 customers, with total sales of 2.79M
  • Accessories led the categories at 883.67K, ahead of Home, Fashion and Electronics
  • Al Ain was the top city by sales (602.63K)
  • Sales peaked in December and dropped sharply in May
  • Only 21% of orders were completed, while refunded and cancelled orders each made up about 27%
